* Scale: The database compiles over 1,700 distinct AI risks extracted from more than 65 published frameworks, industry guidelines, and policy documents. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEB6zswFXimyfJJSRuxK0wjkLoQJAaCk3jLOBZX10rQWIEAEoayFZl1QY3Uf2gzkE7jpDCjyKEvHYx3zQplvD54UX3yo9sRxikpBaK3YMAJBm0cy7_FV1Plly04e5-z2aqKS4DV2CHdlZ7KZ7UgMMXS9ICWZJ0P4N9EvCQzmuXgjADgLPN8YHnL6qhH6pM3OAc), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHrOzAVX-iQCWDCcVVcFzbfswt7arP1K7JHbYMyd_o6KJaR0fy8rpGnF4H2t1yETJ-5LEyt1MTShdyBGdpc04YpwiAuuZXyfgQGerKDOHQfN1s_UR0YR2RjG0bn7lINKGH9JQ-AlC5_1mkouxSMmGHd)]

transcript_class: CAPTURE-TIME VERBATIM RECORD — paste of the expanded Overview with its source cards
d: THE MIT AI RISK REPOSITORY, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a living, open-access database developed by MIT FutureTech' cataloguing over 1,700 risks from more than 65 frameworks; the causal taxonomy (entity, intent, timing), with 38% to 42% of risks attributed to AI systems; the domain taxonomy of seven domains and 24 subdomains, listed; connected tools, the MIT AI Risk Navigator and the Incident Tracker. Ten cards, seven MIT's own, with the arXiv paper (2408.12622) and ScienceDirect.
reading: The innocent reading first. The Overview gives the repository's size, its two taxonomies with the domains named, and the tools built on it, from MIT's pages and the repository's paper.
findings: THE SIZE AND THE TAXONOMY. 1,700 risks from 65 frameworks is the record's count (version 4, December 2025); the seven domains and the causal taxonomy are the record's 'domain taxonomy with subdomains' given at full grain. Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.

THE COUNTS ACROSS VERSIONS. The cards carry three sizes: 777 risks from 43 frameworks (the first release, MIT IDE), 74 frameworks (the arXiv overview card) and 1,700 from 65; the composition gives the current one.

A NEIGHBOUR NOT IN THE CENSUS. The MIT AI Risk Navigator, 'an interactive web tool that links the repository to real-world AI incidents, global governance frameworks... and risk mitigations', is a third MIT surface; the census holds the repository and the tracker. Added as a candidate.
analysis: The repository is composed at a finer grain than the record holds, its taxonomy named domain by domain, and the composition surfaces a sibling the census lacked.
per_note: MIT FutureTech named; no person; arXiv:2408.12622 on a card; MIT's own pages cited.
